column1: # Slice resources (scripts/slice-env). The coordinator appends a row on main with
# `scripts/slice-env --assign` (or `scripts/plan assign`). Do not edit rows. A slot is held while
# the slice is todo, doing or blocked in plan/plan.json. Rows live as long as the plan: when the plan
# ends, the registry goes back to this header (slice IDs start again at S1 in the next plan).
